text_block_list.text:
On the way home from going out with Nice 
Nature...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, isn't that City over there? Is she... 
on a modeling shoot, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Just standing there, she has this 
aura. It feels like she's on a completely 
different dimension.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'd like some more relaxed 
expressions too. Let's take a quick break!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Nature and the others... what's 
wrong?
choice_data_list: I was just about to head home...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Woooow, this is amazing! It's so divine, 
it makes you just wanna put your hands 
together in prayer... y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it feels like to admire 
someone so much you want to worship them. 
Praise be~, praise be~~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft... Ahaha, what's that even mean? 
That's a first for me."

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—Love it, that natural smile! Hey, would 
you girls mind helping with a photoshoot?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Filming...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um... please wait a second. I don't want 
to cause trouble for the two of them.
choice_data_list:
Want to give it a try? You did say you 
admired them.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, that was just a figure of 
speech, you know!? There's no way someone 
like me could ever do that!
choice_data_list: You won't know until you try!
You won't know until you try, you know.
Alright, I'll go!
Then I'll go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, that was just a figure of 
speech, you know!? There's no way someone 
like me could ever do that!
choice_data_list: You won't know until you try!
You won't know until you try, you know.
Alright, I'll go!
Then I'll go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
T-That might be true, but! It's an 
'aspiration' precisely *because* I can't 
do it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I get it too, you know. That 
feeling of not being able to take that 
step, not being able to run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, leave it to me. I'll 
have your back.
choice_data_list: Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious... Seriouslyy~~...!? Can I 
really do this~~!? Me~~...!?
And thus, the photoshoot began...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're even stiffer than I am. 
Let's think of something funny and relax 
for a second.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"S-Something funny!? I don't have the 
leeway to think about that right now!?"
choice_data_list: (Make the goofiest face possible.)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: —Pfft!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what's that, that's totally 
cheating--!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Nice smile, love it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's... over...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Good work, and thank you so much. Everyone 
was raving about the amazing shots we got.
choice_data_list: You two were both sparkling.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... thanks a bunch~~ Even laying on the 
flattery, my oh my.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well, I'll send you the magazine 
once it's finished. You can check it out 
for yourself then.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa... The magazine arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'm taking up the whole screen!? 
Huh!? Isn't that way too much honor for 
me!?
choice_data_list: Look, it's blowing up online too!

Look, people are talking about it online 
too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No!! Just leave it!! I don't wanna see... 
any backlash—

The phone screen was overflowing with 
praise not only for Gold City but also for 
Nice Nature's smile... along with cheering 
comments supporting her success.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...W-Wait, enough. Enough already, I get 
it, so stop it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah...... So hot.
choice_data_list: Let's shine in the race too, yeah?
Let's shine in the race too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.

The training session that followed had far 
more fired-up energy than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yo! As expected of you, Trainer! I'll be 
watching your heroic performance with my 
own two eyes.
And thus, the photoshoot began...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so that's how you became their 
Trainer? You're pretty good yourself.
choice_data_list: I'm deeply honored!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I think I'm starting to get fired up 
too.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Nice smile, love it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, good work~. So, how was your 
modeling debut?
choice_data_list: I was so nervous...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Really? Looked pretty slick to me, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, City-san is really something else. 
She transforms everything around her into 
another world.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Man, I really can't compete with her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's my line.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: City-san!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Guess what she talked about the entire 
time during the shoot? It was all about 
Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh... what's that mean?
choice_data_list: Did it just happen naturally...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Did you really talk about me with a 
smile like that...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Wait, that is so 
embarrassing?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's embarrassing, but it really fired 
me up. I'll be counting on you when we 
race together.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That... "bond" of yours, was it? I'll be 
looking forward to seeing it. Later.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Aww, jeez...
choice_data_list: Let's do our best in the race!
Let's do our best in the race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... This one has no idea how I 
feel...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes, I'll do my best. ...So that I 
can shine in my own way, that is."

The training session that followed had far 
more fired-up energy than usual.
